name: Suomi.fi
body: A content security policy, a security.txt, DMARC, and Core Web Vitals that pass for real visitors. But its HSTS max-age is 604800 seconds, seven days, so a browser that stays away a week forgets to insist on https.
lesson: Raise HSTS max-age to at least a year, 31536000 seconds. Short values protect only frequent visitors.
summary: www.suomi.fi scores 83 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 17 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 2 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /uutiset?p=0. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: AWSALB. Without HttpOnly: csrf-token. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /etusivu, /kansalaiselle, /yritykselle and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 3 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: 6 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 2 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /viestit, /kartta/haku. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
